nodes.text: 1. Form 3 of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure scheme will be enabled shortly

2. Due dates for filing of Income Tax Returns and Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 are extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 vide Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026.
3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

Tax Planning Consultancy: A Comprehensive Guide

involves arranging financial and business affairs within the framework of applicable tax laws to manage tax liability efficiently. It may include using eligible deductions, exemptions, incentives, and appropriate tax structures while maintaining compliance.
Professional tax planning can help individuals and businesses:
Identify legitimate opportunities to manage tax liability.
Align tax planning and reporting with applicable laws and regulations.
Minimize the risk of errors, interest, penalties, and disputes.
Plan tax payments and financial decisions more effectively.
Consider tax implications when making investments, business, or restructuring decisions.
Review business structures, expenses, investments, and applicable tax provisions to support efficient tax management.
Assess income, deductions, investments, and applicable tax provisions based on the individual’s circumstances.
Consider the tax implications of investments, asset sales, and capital gains while making financial decisions.
For cross-border transactions, assess applicable Indian tax provisions, tax treaties, and reporting requirements.
Evaluate the tax implications of changes in business structure, transactions, or investments before implementation.
Develop practical tax-planning approaches based on the client’s circumstances.
Support accurate and timely tax return and reporting requirements.
Identify eligible deductions, exemptions, incentives, and other lawful options.
Assist with documentation and responses to applicable tax proceedings.
Evaluate tax implications of different business structures and transactions.
